title: Qwen3.6-27B FP32-scale INT8 and mixed-layer KV outcome
support_decision: BF16 KV remains the only supported/default dense-27B route. Pure FP32-scale INT8 fails the complete 512/8 quality suite. A selected 9-BF16/7-INT8 layer partition passes the measured quality gates through a bounded 32K prompt, but it is diagnostic-only because its chunk-outer prefill oracles raise peak memory, uniform mixed-INT8 graph capture is unsafe, the executable eager route loses to BF16 graph decode, and no 256K capacity gate exists.

quality_protocol.teacher: same-model BF16 KV with reference-token teacher forcing

pure_int8.verdict: rejected because promotion requires every measured prompt-suite gate; the 512/8 mixed_ja_en_translate prompt reaches only 77.78% top-1 agreement

mixed_layer_candidate.selection_method: deterministic reverse greedy screen on the sole pure-INT8 failing train prompt; admit an INT8 layer only while the prompt remains above the gate
mixed_layer_candidate.selection_caveat: The layer map was selected using mixed_ja_en_translate and therefore is not an independent quality proof. It was subsequently checked on the complete suite, including the remaining train/category prompts, four heldouts, and mixed_v1. It remains diagnostic and must not become prompt-conditioned runtime behavior.

memory.interpretation: The 9/7 map saves retained KV, but GGUF chunk-outer prefill keeps one full-length BF16 K/V oracle pair per INT8 layer. At 32K that transient more than reverses the persistent saving; at 256K the seven oracle pairs alone project to 7 GiB.

runtime_screen.workload: 4K prompt / 128 decode / 32786 requested capacity / one discarded warmup / five measured runs
runtime_screen.interpretation: The executable mixed route is eager-only. It is slightly faster than BF16 eager in this diagnostic, but the supported same-capacity BF16 route uses graph decode, so the product comparison is a 10.52% regression. These dirty-commit diagnostics do not update a performance topline.

runtime_blockers.blocker: uniform per-token/head mixed INT8 is not admitted by decode graph capture
runtime_blockers.evidence: A disposable admission experiment produced a GPU page fault and was reverted; production remains fail-closed to eager for this layout.

runtime_blockers.blocker: full 32K prompt-suite execution is not stable
runtime_blockers.evidence: The complete-suite 32K attempt hung the GPU after reaching INT8 execution. A separately bounded mixed_v1 32K/16 driver completed and passed, so the quality row is only a bounded single-prompt diagnostic.

runtime_blockers.blocker: 256K capacity is unproven and projected transient memory is incompatible with the 24 GiB target
runtime_blockers.evidence: Seven per-layer BF16 prefill oracle pairs project to 7 GiB before other session ownership.
